chunks: Those companions of Muhammad (peace and blessing of Allah be upon him and his family) who were the custodians know that I never disobeyed Allah or His Messenger at all.
And by virtue of the courage with which Allah honoured me, I supported him with my life on occasions when even the brave turned away and feet remained behind.

key_terms.الْمَوَاطِن: Occasions or critical moments (of battle or duty)
key_terms.الْمُسْتَحْفَظُونَ: The custodians or guardians (of divine messages/revelation)

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Ali demonstrate his unwavering loyalty and courage alongside the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: Imam Ali asserts that the 'Mustahfazun' (custodians of divine revelation, often identified as the four chief scribes or the broader circle of trusted companions) were fully aware of his consistent fidelity to Allah and the Prophet. He emphasizes his unique role in providing personal protection and sacrifice during critical moments of battle, particularly highlighting the event of Najd as a testament to his bravery when others faltered. This narration underscores his immediate, tangible support for the Prophet in both spiritual and physical realms, reinforcing his status as the most devoted companion.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Those companions of Muḥammad - the peace and blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants - who were the custodians (of divine messages) know that I never disobeyed Allāh or His Messenger [1] - the peace and blessing of Allāh be upon him and his descendants - at all,
and by virtue of the courage [2] with which Allāh honoured me I supported him with my life on occasions when even the brave turned away and feet remained behind (instead of proceeding forward).
